Build process: 

Make changes to the backend in a markdown document for each blog post. 

Build this with "sudo bundle exec jekyll build". 

Go into the frontend, `_site` folder, and now add, commit, and push the build changes.

The "_site" folder has its origin towards the "lassearpe.github.io", which is why it is important to push from this repo. 

This automatically pushes the changes to the "lassearpe.github.io" repo.
